shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work and hauling, linked weather, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency).
- Cap: 3 levels per column, enforced in LevelMapGen and PlaceWorker_ABStairs.
- Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics (documented deviations: floor removal only drops on exposed air; bomb rooftop holes deferred).
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock matching surface geology, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches; HarmonyBoot per-class patching; fail open everywhere.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (end of T3.2)
- Core: LevelComp registry on aligned pocket maps; stairs pairs generate levels; StairTransfer moves pawns AND carried cargo (detach before despawn, reattach after, loss-proof fallbacks); PageUp/PageDown level view.
- Sky mountains: contracted mass, ledge ring, two lit unroofed face rows, fogged thick-roofed core, guaranteed fog reveal on mining.
- See-below renderer: content-only section copies at y=-2.5, air-cells light mask, live dynamic things below, far clip 70.
- Weather link: sky adopts ground weather every 150 ticks.
- Live sync (MapEvents): roof below governs rooftop above; sky floors write roofs below; things over air fall.
- Cross-level work: virtual scan at the stairwell exit; idle return; drafted gizmos; colony-wide Work/Schedule tables.
- Cross-level hauling: storage-driven (strictly-greater priority on a linked level, vanilla StoreUtility decides) plus construction-demand-driven (CrossLevelDemand caches remaining blueprint/frame needs AND per-def availability every 600 ticks; materials flow toward demanding levels; QUANTITY-AWARE pinning keeps only what a level still needs, surplus exports normally). Right-click float menu option "Haul X to the level above/below" (auto-discovered provider, same destination logic, player-forced). Verdict cache shared across pawns. Known behavior: autonomous fetching FROM another level rides the idle-migration path (~20s cadence); the right-click option is the immediate manual tool.
- Cross-level needs: bed redirect on linked levels; hunger and recreation via idle-return drift.
- One-colony resources: every column map's ResourceCounter counts all levels.

## Quadruple pass log
T3.2: pin math verified (need 20 of 500 exports 425 freely; exact-need stacks stay), availability snapshot drift bounded by TTL and self-corrects via demand pull; float option costs only on right-click and reuses TargetLevelFor as the single source of truth. Confidence: pin fix 90%, float option 88%, cargo transfer 92%, demand hauling 84%.
Known gaps: bills do not actively fetch across levels; patient/medical beds same-level; two-hop redirects fall back; autonomous cross-level fetch latency ~20s.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T2 DONE. T3.2 CODE DONE (awaiting test).
- T4: systems: temperature sync, power across levels, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling; renderer polish; publishing prep per global rules.

## Status
T3.2 compiled green, pushed. Pending test: stockpile flow with a live blueprint present, right-click cross-level haul, construction pull.
